# Lysozyme molecular evolution in flies and insects data

This repository contains datasets and scripts used in the manuscript "*Lysozyme molecular evolution in insects reveals feeding habit adaptations in brachyceran flies*".

## Files

-   `01_sequences`: recovered lysozyme gene sequences for Calliphoridae and insect annotated genes (including NCBI accessions);
-   `02_iqtree`: MSAs and iqtree outputs for Calliphoridae C-type lysozymes and insecta lysozymes trees;
-   `03_phylo_stats`: data and scripts used in phylogenetic comparative analyses;
-   `04_selection_analyses`: MSAs, trees and outputs used and generated by CodeML and RELAX selection analyses.
